$comment: CrossFit sometimes issues an athlete a new competitorId, which splits one
career across several records and silently drops the shorter fragments below
the minimum-appearances threshold. This maps duplicate ids onto a canonical
one (normally the id with the most appearances).
Only merge when the evidence is strong: the years must not overlap (nobody
competes twice in the same year), and height, age progression and affiliate
should line up. `npm run fetch` reports any suspected split that is not
listed here, so new ones surface rather than sitting unnoticed.

3180.why: 2011 (2nd, 3 event wins) was recorded under a separate id. Age 28 in 2011 fits 30 in 2013. The 2011 profile's 71 in / 215 lb is bad data — the later record's 65 in / 173 lb matches him.

163784.why: 2013 fragment. Same 71 in height and CrossFit Grandview affiliate as 2011-12; age 26 in 2012 to 28 in 2013 fits.

262945.why: 2015 fragment, third id for the same athlete. Same 71 in height, age 30 in 2015 fits, affiliate moved Grandview to Hilliard (both Ohio).

145925.why: 2013 fragment. Identical 77 in height and Behemoth CrossFit affiliate; age 24 in 2012 to 26 in 2013 fits.

99039.why: 2013 fragment. Age 22 in 2013 to 23 in 2014 fits. The 2013 record's 6 in height is a data-entry error.
